PROJECT GANTT CHART & COMPLETE SDLC IMPLEMENTATION SCHEDULE
Project: Petsy (Pet Care & Health Management Platform) · Planning, Requirement Analysis, Design, Coding (All Modules), Testing & Deployment
SDLC PHASES & FUNCTIONAL MODULE WORK PACKAGES
WBS Code · SDLC Phase / Module Name · Component Reference · Role
Project Charter, Scope, Technical & Operational Feasibility Analysis
Functional & Non-Functional Specs, Pet Parent Personas & System Constraints
System Architecture, ERD & Level-0/1 DFD Design
High-Level Mobile Architecture, Firestore NoSQL Collections & DFD Models
PHASE 4: CODING & MODULE IMPLEMENTATION (CORE APPLICATION LOGIC)
Module 1: User Auth & Multi-Role Access (Customer & Admin)
AuthScreen.js, Firebase Auth, Session Persistence, Role Verification Logic
Admin Panel, User Accounts Management, System Analytics & Auditing
Module 3: Customer Home Dashboard & Active Pet Switching
HomeScreen.js, Active Pet Selector, Weight Preview, Care Tips & Dynamic Banner

ProfileScreen.js, AddPetForm.js, Breed/Species/DOB Details, Profile Cards
Module 5: Weight Tracker & Interactive Growth Charts
LogWeightForm.js, Historical Weight Tracking, Chart Visualization, Ideal Range
RemindersScreen.js, AddReminderForm.js, Date/Time Picker, Category Filter, Due States
RecordsScreen.js, AddRecordForm.js, Vaccinations, Medications, Vet Visits, Data Export
Module 8: Settings, Theme Engine & User Account
SettingsScreen.js, Dark/Light/System Mode, Profile Updates, Secure Sign-Out
Jest Test Suites, Input Validations, Firestore Mock Testing, State Flows
End-to-End User Journeys, Expo Mobile Device Testing, Accessibility & UI QA
Mobile Build & Production Setup (EAS / Web Build)
Expo EAS Build, Android APK Generation, Firebase Cloud Rules & Web Hosting
PHASE 7: MAINTENANCE, FINAL DOCUMENTATION & VIVA-VOCE DEFENSE
